about: The colophon of the book: how it was brought out of Arabic into Geʿez, the translator Isaac's plea for prayers, and a closing list of kings, from Bazen to Amda Seyon, as the text names them.

sentences.i: And it was said in an Arabic writing: we brought it out from the book of the Copts into Arabic, from the throne of Mark the evangelist, the teacher, the father of us all;
sentences.n: Colophon: a new voice, a translator's first person plural. ወ- 'and' + ተብህለ 'it was said' (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ 'say'; compare ይቤ). በክታበ ዐረቢ 'in an Arabic writing' is taken with ተብህለ (an adjunct right after its verb), so what follows is the quotation; it could instead go with አውፃእናሃ ('we brought it out in Arabic writing') (?). አውፃእናሃ is አውፅአ 'bring out' with 1cp ending -ነ and 3fs object -ሃ 'it' (the book, መጽሐፍ, treated as feminine in this text: ዛቲ መጽሐፍ, ወተረክበት); 'bring out' is the usual word for publishing or rendering a text. እም- 'from' also on እመጽሐፈ, እመንበረ. ቅብጥ 'the Copts'; መንበር 'throne' (here of Mark the evangelist; the text does not name Alexandria). አበ ኵልነ 'father of all of us': ኵሉ + -ነ.

sentences.l: And-we-brought-out-it in-400 and-9 year-of mercy, in land-of Ethiopia, in-days-of Gäbrä Mäsqäl king, and-ሰጓሁ (unexplained) Lalibäla; in-days-of Abba Giyorgis bishop good; and-(completed?) God its-bringing-out and-its-translation to speech-of Abyssinian; and-when I-pondered this: why not-they-translated-it Abelʿəz and-Abelfäräg who they-brought-it-out; I-said this: because it-went-out in-days-of Zagʷa, and-not-they-translated-it; because says this book: those-indeed who they-reign who not-are Əsraʾel, transgressing law it-is;
sentences.i: And we brought it out in the four hundred and ninth year of mercy, in the land of Ethiopia, in the days of King Gebre Mesqel, and … (ሰጓሁ, unexplained) Lalibela; in the days of Abba Giyorgis, the good bishop; and God completed (?) its bringing out and its translation into the Abyssinian speech. And when I pondered this — why did they not translate it, Abelʿəz and Abelfäräg (names as written, unexplained), who brought it out — I said this: it is because it came out in the days of the Zagwe, and they did not translate it; for this book says: as for those who reign who are not Israel, it is a transgression of the law.
sentences.n: A long unit (54 words), kept whole; the source has no ፤ inside it. ዓመተ ምሕረት 'year of mercy' is the Ethiopian era-name, so ፬፻ወ፱ is year 409 of that era; the date is the colophon's own, and nothing here reconciles it with the persons named, so no calendar equivalent is given. Gebre Mesqel is read as the king's name ('servant of the cross'); the text does not itself say whether he and Lalibela are one man or two. ወሰጓሁ ላሊበላ is obscure (?): ሰጓሁ is not identified (a verb with 3ms suffix -ሁ? a name or epithet?) and is left unrendered. ወአስተተ is unresolved (?): no root is identified; 'completed' is only the sense the clause seems to need (God … its bringing-out and its translation). ኀበ 'to'; ነገረ ሐባሲ 'speech of the Abyssinian' (ሐባሲ, nisba, here collective). አበልዕዝ and አበልፈረግ are not analysed (?): they may be personal names or descriptions; they stand with እለ አውፅእዋ 'who brought it out', so they are the earlier bringers-out. እቤ 'I said' (1cs of ይቤ, root ብህለ). ዛጓ 'Zagwe' as the text spells it; presumably the line meant by the 'not Israel' reasoning that follows. ኢተርጐምዋ: negated ተርጐመ 'translate' with 3mp ending and 3fs object -ዋ 'it'. እስመ ትብል: 'for … says' with the book (fem.) as subject. እለሰ ይነግሡ እለ ኢኮኑ እስራኤል 'as for those who reign, who are not Israel' (-ሰ marks contrast); ተዐድዎ ሕግ ውእቱ 'it is a transgressing of the law': ተዐድዎ the verbal noun of ተዐደወ with ሕግ as its object, ውእቱ the copula. The sense is fairly clear, the exact construction is not (?).

sentences.i: And when it is in the kingdom of Israel, from [the time] they brought it out (?);
sentences.n: Obscure (?): the clause is cut short. ሶበ 'when' + ይከውን (3ms imperfect of ኮነ 'be, become'); the subject is unstated (3ms, whereas the book is feminine, ወተረክበት, so it is not simply the book). እምአውፅእዋ is እም- 'from' + አውፅእዋ 'they brought it out' (3mp + 3fs), read 'from their bringing it out'. sentences.i: And pray for me, for your servant Isaac, the poor man, and do not blame me (?) for not making straight the speech of the language;
sentences.n: Isaac is the translator, speaking in his own voice (inferred from the plea for his work). ወጸልዩ is ጸለየ 'pray' in the 2mp imperative; ላዕሌየ 'upon me' (ላዕለ + -የ). ለገብርክሙ: ለ- + ገብር 'servant' + -ክሙ 'your (mp)'. ወኢትሒሱኒ: ኢ- + a 2mp jussive + -ኒ 'me'; the root is not securely identified (?) and 'blame, reproach' is taken from context. ኢያርትዖ is the negated verbal noun (infinitive) of አርትዐ 'make straight', with ነገረ ልሳን 'the speech of the language' as its object, the actor being Isaac: 'not making straight'.

sentences.i: For I laboured much for the glory of the land of Ethiopia, for the going out of heavenly Zion, and for the glory of the king of Ethiopia; for I too asked him, the just governor, the beloved of God, Yaʿbika Egzi (?) ('the Lord makes you great'); and he loved (?), and he said to me, 'Do [it]';
sentences.n: እስመ 'for' opens the reason. ብዙኀ is an adverbial accusative 'much'. በእንተ ክብራ ለሀገረ ኢትዮጵያ is 'for her glory, of the land': a possessive suffix anticipates the owner, introduced by ለ-; so also ጸአታ ለጽዮን. In this book Zion is the Ark, and its 'going out' (from Jerusalem to Ethiopia) is the book's subject; ሰማያዊት 'heavenly' is feminine to agree with ጽዮን. ተስእልክዎ: 1cs perfect 'I asked' + 3ms object -ዎ, doubled by ለመኰንን; 'governor, judge' with ርቱዕ 'just' and ፍቁረ እግዚኣብሔር 'beloved of God' (construct) in apposition. The next words are doubtful (?). ያዕቢከ እግዚእ looks like a personal name of the governor, 'the Lord makes you great' (ያዕቢ 3ms of አዕበየ 'make great' + -ከ 'you', እግዚእ 'Lord'), in apposition to him; it could instead be a spoken blessing, but then the sentence has no reported speech to carry it. ወአፍቀረ 'and he loved' has no stated object ('approved'? (?)). ወይቤለኒ ግበር: 'and he said to me: do!' (ግበር 2ms imperative).

sentences.i: And I did it, while God helped me, and he did not repay me according to my sin. Pray for your servant Isaac, and for those who laboured with me in the going out of this book, for we were greatly distressed (?), I myself. May the Father have mercy on (or: teach) us (?), and Hizb Kristos, Andreyas, Filipos, and Mehari Ab (?) — may God have mercy on them in the kingdom of heaven, with all the saints and martyrs; may he write their names in the book of life, for ever and ever. Amen and amen.
sentences.n: A long unit (45 words); the closing ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is a row of end-marks. እንዘ 'while' + the imperfect ይረድአኒ 'he helps me' (ረድአ + -ኒ). ወኢፈደየኒ: ፈደየ 'repay' + -ኒ; አበሳ 'sin, fault' + -የ. ተመንደብነ is not secure (?): a quadriliteral tä-stem with 1cp ending, 'we were distressed' from context only. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'; አነ 'I' repeated for emphasis after 'we'. ወይምሀረነ is a 3ms jussive + -ነ 'us'; spelled with ሀ it is the verb መሀረ 'teach' (compare መምህር, unit 0) rather than መሐረ 'have mercy' (as in ይምሐሮሙ below, spelled with ሐ); 'have mercy' is kept for the parallel but 'teach' is the form as written (?). The string ሕዝበ ክርስቶስ ወእንድርያስ ወፊልጶስ ወመሓሪ አብ is ambiguous (?): it may be the names of the fellow-labourers (Hizb Kristos, 'people of Christ'; Andreyas; Filipos; Mehari Ab, 'merciful Father'), which would give ይምሐሮሙ 'may he have mercy on them' its referent; or Christ's people, Andrew, Philip and the Father as further subjects. The verb agrees only with አብ (singular). The second reading is not taken. ይጽሐፍ is the active 3ms jussive of ጸሐፈ 'write': 'let him write their names' (subject understood, God); a passive would be ይትጻሐፍ. 'Book of life' recalls Philippians 4:3 and Revelation 3:5. ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for ever and ever'; ኵሎሙ 'all of them' (ኵሉ + -ሙ).

sentences.i: And after our Saviour was born: these are the kings.
sentences.n: A new section: a list of kings. እምድኅረ 'after' + ተወልደ 'was born' (tä-stem passive of ወለደ), subject መድኀኒነ 'our Saviour' (መድኀኒ + -ነ). እሉ is the plural 'these', ነገሥት 'kings' (broken plural of ንጉሥ). The units that follow end at ፤, mostly one name each (some hold two or three: አብርሃ ወአጽብሐ, አርፍድ ወአምሲ); the list ends at ፨. The Geʿez spellings are kept exactly; the English forms are conventional spellings of the names, and no name is given a sense unless a note says so.

sentences.i: And after him the kingdom was taken away (?) to a people who were not of the tribe of David and the people of Israel;
sentences.n: ወእምድኅሬሁ 'and after him' (እምድኅረ + -ሁ). ተሀይደ is uncertain (?): the house reading is 'was taken away' (3ms perfect passive, stem uncertain), possibly from a root ሀየደ 'go, depart' (not checked against Dillmann here); 'passed' would be the sense the clause needs. ለሕዝብ 'to a people'; እለ ኢኮኑ 'who are not' (ኮነ negated). ነገድ 'tribe', ዳዊት David. The people meant are not named here; they are presumably those of the colophon's 'not Israel' reasoning above (?).

glossary.ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel') · accusative in apposition to መንታ: ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples' (the twins as heads of lines) (?) · or construct 'the two peoples of Perez and Zerah' (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ ፋሬስ ወዛራ) (?) · in king-names: ሕዝበ አናኒ, ሕዝበ አርዓድ (construct 'people of' as name element, no sense claimed) · ሕዝበ ክርስቶስ in the colophon: read as a name, 'Hizb Kristos' (?)
glossary.ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
glossary.መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
glossary.መጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — a book (noun, accusative) · construct 'book of' (መጽሐፈ ሕግ 'the book of the law', ch. 55)
glossary.ማርቆስ: ማርቆስ — name of Mark the evangelist (proper name)
glossary.ማአልባጋድ: ማአልባጋድ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ማዕዳይ: ማዕዳይ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ምስሌየ: ምስለ — with me (preposition, stem ምስሌ- + -የ '1cs me')
glossary.ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you') · in king-name ፍሬ ሠናይ: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate) · predicate before a subjunctive, 'it is right that' (ርቱዕ ንስግድ 'it is right that we bow')
glossary.ሰልዓዶባ: ሰልዓዶባ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ሰርዓዳ: ሰርዓዳ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ሰርጓይ: ሰርጓይ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ሰገድ: ሰገድ — name element (proper name); has the form of ሰገደ 'bow down' (3ms perfect or imperative); no sense claimed for the names
glossary.ሰፍር: ሰፍር — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (second element of ግርማ ሰፍር)
glossary.ሳፍ: ሳፍ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of ሳፍ አርዓድ)
glossary.ቅብጥ: ቅብጥ — the Copts, Egypt (proper name, collective)
glossary.ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies') · adjective 'holy', plural, before or after a noun (ቅዱሳን ካህናት 'holy priests'; ለሐዋርያቲሁ ቅዱሳን 'to his holy apostles')
glossary.ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back') · in king-name ቅድመ ሰገድ: 'before' (?) as name element
glossary.በመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — in the kingdom of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በመዋዕለ: መዋዕል — in the days of (በ- + plural of ዕለት, construct)
glossary.በናዝሬት: ናዝሬት — in Nazareth (በ- 'in' + place name, proper name)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በክታበ: ክታብ — in the writing of, in the book of (በ- + noun, construct) (?)
glossary.በዘኢኮነ: ኮነ — with that which is not (በ- 'with' + ዘ 'that which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.በዘጋር: በዘጋር — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (በ- is taken as part of the name) (?)
glossary.በደግዝ: በደግዝ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.በጋማይ: በጋማይ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.በፀአተ: ጸአት — in the going out of, in the bringing forth of (በ- + noun, construct; spelled with ፀ)
glossary.በ፬፻: ፬፻ — spoken አርባዕቱ ምእት (ʾarbaʿtu məʾət) 'four hundred' (numeral, with prefixed በ- 'in')
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
glossary.ባሕር: ባሕር — sea (noun) · in king-name ባሕር ሰገድ: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.ባዜን: ባዜን — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
glossary.ተሀይደ: ተሀይደ — he/it was taken away (3ms perfect passive; uncertain stem) · here of the kingdom (ወእምድኅሬሁ ተሀይደ መንግሥት ለሕዝብ): the same sense, 'was taken away' (?); stem and root not checked
glossary.ተመንደብነ: ተመንደበ — we were afflicted, distressed (?) (1cp perfect, quadriliteral tä-stem; meaning from context) (?)
glossary.ተስእልክዎ: ተስእለ — I asked him (1cs perfect, tä-stem of ሰአለ with active sense 'ask', + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
glossary.ታዜና: ታዜና — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 2ms 'you say' (ሶበ ጸብሐ ትብል 'when it is morning you say')
glossary.ኀለይኩ: ኀለየ — I thought, pondered (1sg perfect, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
glossary.ነአድ: ነአድ — Näʾad, name of a king (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying') · in ኀበ ነገረ ሐባሲ 'into the speech of the Abyssinians' (construct 'speech of') · ነገረ ልሳን 'the speech of the language' (construct, object of ኢያርትዖ)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us') · accusative object 'a king' (ወለደት ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'she bore a heavenly king')
glossary.አልዓሚዳ: አልዓሚዳ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article) · in king-name ይኵኖ አምላክ: name element (no sense claimed)

glossary.አርማኅ: አርማኅ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (spelled with ኅ)
glossary.አርዓዳ: አርዓዳ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አርዓድ: አርዓድ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of several names)
glossary.አርፍድ: አርፍድ — Arfed, name of a king (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አስግድ: አስግድ — name element (proper name); not analysed, no sense claimed
glossary.አስፋ: አስፋ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of ግርማ አስፋ)
glossary.አስፋሕ: አስፋሕ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አስፍሐ: አስፍሐ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አስፍሕ: አስፍሕ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of ዠን አስፍሕ)
glossary.አቀንኦሙ: አቀንአ — I will make them jealous (1cs imperfect of the causative of ቀንአ 'be jealous' + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አበልዕዝ: አበልዕዝ — Abelʿəz, obscure (?): perhaps a personal name or title of the earlier translators (?)
glossary.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
glossary.አብርሃ: አብርሃ — Abreha, name of one of the two brother kings (አብርሃ ወአጽብሐ አኀው ፍቁራን; proper name)
glossary.አኀው: አኅ — brothers (plural of አኅ, አኀው) · siblings, brother and sister together (፪ አኀው 'two siblings')
glossary.አነ: አነ — I · here emphatic 'I' after the verb (ተመንደብነ ፈድፋደ አነ 'we were distressed, I [too]') and before አቀንኦሙ 'I [will make jealous]'
glossary.አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also') · here 'for I also' (እስመ አነሂ ተስእልክዎ)
glossary.አናኒ: አናኒ — Anani, name or word not analysed (?) (second element of ሕዝበ አናኒ)
glossary.አንበሳ: አንበሳ — lion (noun) · in king-name አንበሳ ወድም: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.አውፃእናሃ: አውፅአ — we brought it out (1cp perfect, causative of ወጽአ, + -ሃ '3fs it')
glossary.አውፅእዋ: አውፅአ — they brought it out (3mp perfect, causative of ወጽአ, + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.አውፅኦታ: አውፅአ — her bringing out (verbal noun of causative አውፅአ + -ሃ '3fs her'; fem. antecedent the book)
glossary.አይዙር: አይዙር — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አድርዓዝ: አድርዓዝ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.አግብአ: አግብአ — he returned, gave back (3ms perfect, causative of ገብአ)
glossary.አግዳር: አግዳር — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ኢተርጐምዋ: ተርጐመ — they did not translate it (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ኢኮኑ: ኮነ — they were not (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢያርትዖ: አርትዐ — not setting straight (ኢ- 'not' + infinitive/verbal noun አርትዖ of the causative አርትዐ 'make straight')
glossary.እለሰ: እለ — those, indeed (relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እመንበረ: መንበር — from the throne of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እመጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — from the book of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምነገደ: ነገድ — from the tribe of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምአውፅእዋ: አውፅአ — from their bringing it out (እም- 'from' + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs it') (?)
glossary.እስመ: እስመ — for, because · before a clause quoting what the book says (እስመ ትብል ዛቲ መጽሐፍ 'for this book says')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እቤ: ይቤ — I said (1cs perfect of ብህለ, b-h-l, the defective verb; for the usual እቤ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ከላውድዮስ: ከላውድዮስ — Claudius (proper name, the Geʿez form of the Greek-derived name)
glossary.ካሌብ: ካሌብ — Caleb (proper name; king of Ethiopia)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ክብራ: ክብር — her glory (noun + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለጽዮን 'of Zion'; not a construct)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered') · in king-name ኵሉ ለጽዮን: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55) · 'all those' as antecedent of the relative እለ (እምነ ኵሎሙ እለ ፈጠረ 'above (?) all those whom he created')
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and the people of (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'people of')
glossary.ወመሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful, one who forgives (active participle, masc. sg.; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወሰማዕት: ሰማዕት — and martyrs, witnesses (ወ- + noun ሰማዕት, read as plural) (?)
glossary.ወሰጓሁ: ሰጓሁ — obscure (?): sägʷahu with ወ- 'and'; perhaps a verb with -ሁ '3ms him', or a name; lemma not identified, left unresolved (?)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወተረክበት: ተረክበ — and she was found (ወ- + 3fs perfect, passive of ረከበ)
glossary.ወተርጒሞታ: ተርጐመ — and her translation (ወ- + verbal noun of ተርጐመ + -ሃ '3fs her'; the noun form ተርጒሞት is not checked against Dillmann (?))
glossary.ወተብህለ: ተብህለ — and it was said (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ, b-h-l)
glossary.ወአምሲ: አምሲ — and Amsi (ወ- + proper name, the other of the two brother kings)
glossary.ወአስተተ: አስተተ — and (?) astätä, obscure (?): ወ- + a 3ms perfect-like form; no lemma or root identified; 'completed' is only the sense the clause seems to need (?)
glossary.ወአበልፈረግ: አበልፈረግ — and Abelfäräg, obscure (?): perhaps a personal name or title (ወ- 'and' + name) (?)
glossary.ወአውፃእናሃ: አውፅአ — and we brought it out (ወ- + 1cp perfect, causative of ወጽአ, + -ሃ '3fs it')
glossary.ወአጽብሐ: አጽብሐ — and Aṣbəḥä (ወ- + proper name, the other of the two brother kings)
glossary.ወአፍቀረ: አፍቀረ — and he loved (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative)
glossary.ወኢተርጐምዋ: ተርጐመ — and they did not translate it (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ወኢትሒሱኒ: ወኢትሒሱኒ — and do not blame me (?) (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive + -ኒ '1cs me'); lemma and root not identified (?), sense from context only
glossary.ወኢፈደየኒ: ፈደየ — and he did not repay me (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ወእንድርያስ: እንድርያስ — and Andreyas, Andrew (ወ- + proper name; here read as one of the names after ሕዝበ ክርስቶስ) (?)
glossary.ወይምሀረነ: መሀረ — and may he teach us (?) (ወ- + 3ms jussive + -ነ '1cp us'); spelled with ሀ, which is መሀረ 'teach' (cf. መምህር); the context may rather want መሐረ 'have mercy' (cf. ይምሐሮሙ) (?)
glossary.ወይቤለኒ: ይቤ — and he said to me (ወ- + 3ms perfect + ለ- 'to' + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወድም: ወድም — Wädm, name element (proper name; sense not claimed): read with አንበሳ as one name (?); or ወ- 'and' + a name ድም (?)
glossary.ወገበርኩ: ገብረ — and I did, made (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G)
glossary.ወጸልዩ: ጸለየ — and pray! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, G, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ወፅአት: ወጽአ — she went out (3fs perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወፊልጶስ: ፊልጶስ — and Filipos, Philip (ወ- + proper name; as the preceding) (?)
glossary.ወ፱: ፱ — spoken ተስዐቱ (täsʿätu) 'nine' (numeral, with prefixed ወ- 'and')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ውድም: ውድም — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of ውድም አርዓድ)
glossary.ዓምደ: ዓምድ — pillar (noun, construct 'pillar of'); first element of the name ዓምደ ጽዮን, no sense claimed for the name
glossary.ዘርአይ: ዘርአይ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ዘንተ: ዝንቱ — this (demonstrative, accusative masc. sg.) · here as 'this' standing alone (ኀለይኩ ዘንተ 'I considered this'; እቤ ዘንተ 'I said this')
glossary.ዛን: ዛን — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of ዛን አስግድ)
glossary.ዛጓ: ዛጓ — Zagʷa, as the text spells it (proper name, presumably the Zagwe dynasty; not explained in the text) (?)
glossary.ዝመዝ: ዝመዝ — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ዠን: ዠን — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (ዠ writes ž)
glossary.ዣን: ዣን — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (ዣ writes ž)
glossary.ያዕቢከ: አዕበየ — he makes you great (?) (3ms imperfect/jussive, causative of ዐበየ + -ከ '2ms you'); in the unit taken as part of the governor's name ያዕቢከ እግዚእ (?)
glossary.ያግባ: ያግባ — Yagba, name (proper name); not a form of አግብአ (whose jussive would be ያግብእ); sense not claimed
glossary.ይምሐሮሙ: መሐረ — may he have mercy on them (3ms jussive + -ሙ '3mp them') (?)
glossary.ይረድአኒ: ረድአ — he helps me (3ms imperfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ይኵኖ: ይኵኖ — Yəkʷno, name (proper name); form not analysed, sense not claimed (a link with ኮነ 'be' is conceivable but unproved) (?)
glossary.ይጽሐፍ: ጸሐፈ — let him write (3ms jussive, G, ṣ-ḥ-f)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድል: ድል — name element (proper name), first element of ድል ነአድ; not analysed, no sense claimed
glossary.ድግና: ድግና — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed) (element of ድግና ሚካኤል)
glossary.ድግናዛን: ድግናዛን — name of a king in the list (proper name; sense not claimed)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ጊዮርጊስ: ጊዮርጊስ — name of George, Giyorgis (proper name)
glossary.ግርማ: ግርማ — majesty, awe (noun, masc.) · in king-names ግርማ ሰፍር, ግርማ አስፋ: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.ጳጳስ: ጳጳስ — bishop (noun, singular; in apposition to ጎርጎርዮስ)
glossary.ጸአታ: ጸአት — her going out (noun + -ሃ '3fs her', anticipating ለጽዮን; not a construct)
glossary.ጻመውኩ: ጸመወ — I laboured (1cs perfect, G, ṣ-m-w)
glossary.ጽንፈ: ጽንፈ — name element (proper name); the form is the construct of ጽንፍ 'end, edge'; no sense claimed for the name ጽንፈ አስግድ
glossary.ጽዮን: ጽዮን — Zion · in king-names ጽዮን ሕግ, ያግባ ጽዮን, ዓምደ ጽዮን: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.ፃመዉ: ጸመወ — they laboured (3mp perfect, G, ṣ-m-w; spelled with ፃ)
glossary.ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
glossary.ፍሬ: ፍሬ — fruit (noun, construct 'fruit of') · in king-name ፍሬ ሠናይ: name element (no sense claimed)
glossary.ፍቁረ: ፍቁር — the Beloved (passive participle of ፈቀረ, accusative; object of ረሰየ)
glossary.ፍቁራን: ፍቁር — beloved ones (plural of ፍቁር, passive participle of ፈቀረ, masc. pl.)
